changes.notes: Second fix round on the go-live plan after audit 1 of 0.2.1 failed on one docs Medium. Section 6, STATE.md and the PR text now say the same one rule as section 4 (no customer reaches payment until D3 items 1 to 10 and D4 pass on the same run; during D1 to D3 the flags are ON only behind the audited owner-only gate, which sits in front of the flag). Two safety checks that no test watches (spend.js lines 262 and 224) are listed honestly; later checks stop any extra money. Lock-freeze wording now covers the admin sweep (about 100 seconds worst case). preparedAt is the real commit time. Test G21 no longer depends on speed. No source code changed, no money behaviour changed, nothing deployed, no flag changed.

Fix round after two independent audits of 0.2.0. Go-live plan (docs/GO-LIVE.md) now: says plainly that the owner's Rs 1 test runs only through an owner-only gate and shows a non-owner account is refused; lists the call to IT Services inside the database transaction (freezes everything for up to 4 seconds) with its risk and fix as a gate before customers; adds the webhook address check as a gate; corrects the rollback step for missing credits (repeat rail/confirm, not credit_purchase); says a pause also refuses payment confirmations; other wording fixes. Three more safety rules are now watched by tests (46 listed guards). The log cleaner now looks at the first 2000 characters only so a huge input cannot make it slow. No money behaviour changed, nothing deployed, no flag changed.

Go-live preparation, nothing turned on. Adds docs/GO-LIVE.md (ordered steps, secret names, the owner's own Rs 1 test, flags that stay OFF, rollback). Forged or unsigned calls are now refused before they can queue on the single writer. Internal-error logs no longer carry e-mails or long secrets. The open health page asks the payment side at most once every 30 seconds. New check for any real payment-side adapter (railContract). New 'npm run guards' proves a test fails when each safety guard is removed. Also includes the console wallet module and the fixed INR pack price (in the repo since 19 Nov, never deployed) and the version files from PR 1.

First live version of the Moneypenny credit ledger on its Cloudflare Worker (code 65b86c8, deployed 19 Nov 2026 IST; time shown is that commit's time because the exact deploy time was not recorded). Built over 17 to 19 Nov 2026 from the Phase 0 build and 19 audit rounds: ledger, spend holds, price list, FX table, AI-ready API, API contract, SQLite Durable Object executor. No payment side or rate source is connected. Changes made after this code (INR fixed pack price and the console wallet module) are in the repo but not deployed; see CHANGELOG.md, Not yet deployed.
